Two banks pay interest in the following ways.
Bank A
Simple interest at a rate of 2.5% per year for the first year and then compound interest at a
rate of 1.5% per year for each year after that.
Bank B
Simple interest at 1.6% per year.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Cherie invested $3000 in Bank A on 1st January 2016.
Find how much the investment will be worth on 1st January 2019.
